label: Stop tagged runs
description: Stop every run of this project carrying a tag, waiting runs included: a run parked on a person or a timer never resumes. Every input wired onto the node is a tag to stop; `includeSelf` stops this run too. Put a `TagRun` first: a stop only reaches runs tagged before this one, so runs arriving together do not stop each other.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.description: Tags to stop, as one list. Wired inputs of your own are tags too; the two add up.

inputs.name: includeSelf
inputs.label: Stop this run too
inputs.description: Off: stop the other runs carrying the tag and keep this one. On: stop every run carrying the tag, this one included; this run ends cancelled the same way `weft stop` ends one.

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True once the stop is queued. Wire it into the `_should_flow` of the work that follows.
